raised.$description: Lifted above a sibling in the same component — a hovered segment, a checkbox input over its box

popover.$description: Anchored floating chrome: dropdown panels, tooltips. Four components chose 100 independently, which is what makes this a layer rather than a number

overlay.$description: Anything that must cover a popover — the nav's module panel today, a modal scrim when one exists. Pairs with bg-overlay

map-control.$description: What a pilot surface does to the map under it (ADR-0172): with bg-map-control, the imagery reads as colour, not detail

map-read.$description: What a reading surface does to the map under it (ADR-0172): with bg-map-read, almost opaque — the text is long
